subject: Renewal: service augmentation, regional failover & pricing confirmation
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily@fastretail.co>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, May 1 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract renewal — regional failover & higher throughput

Vanessa,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting renewal planning for FastRetail — our contract rolls on 2028-07-01. Over the last 12 months our traffic has grown ~3x and we plan another 2x during peak season. Two asks from our side:

- We want to add a Premium SLA tier (latency SLOs: 95th <= 150ms, 99th <= 400ms) and a 24/7 response window for Ops.
- Regional failover: we need a standby region in us-west for DR and a documented failover runbook.

Can you share a quote for a committed capacity uplift (~2x tokens/month), the delta to add Premium SLA, and any one-time onboarding effort? I attached our growth plan and a short Ops doc.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call this week.

— Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Platform Engineering, FastRetail
em: emily@fastretail.co
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, May 2 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal — regional failover & higher throughput

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear note and the growth deck. This is exactly the kind of renewal where we can design a staged uplift that balances unit economics with reliability. High level: 

- We can commit to the latency SLOs you listed by certifying a Premium SLA add-on and a standby region reservation in us-west.
- For the 2x committed throughput, we recommend a two-quarter ramp: a 1.5x committed uplift now, with a built-in option to convert burst to reserved if usage stabilizes.
- One-time onboarding (failover runbook, on-call playbook, DR test) is estimated at ~40 engineer-hours; we’ll include runbook creation and a tabletop DR test.

I attached a preliminary quote (Redwood-Premium-SLA-Quote-2028.pdf). Quick asks: can you confirm target token/month target for Q3 and whether legal prefers a single amendment or a short-term addendum?

I’m happy to present the proposal with Marissa and Ben — how’s Thursday 11am PT?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Call scheduled with customer Thursday 11am PT (invites sent).

Vanessa / Marissa — quick take after reviewing the deck and initial quote: 

- Approve staged approach. Offer: 15% discount on the incremental reserved capacity for the first 6 months; if they convert to a 12-month reserved contract within that window, apply a conversion credit equal to 50% of the discount they received (i.e., retroactive rebate).
- Premium SLA add-on: price at +18% of current committed spend (covers standby region reservation + 24/7 Ops). Include an explicit SLO remediation credit table in the amendment.
- One-time onboarding: we will absorb up to 20 hours; balance billed at our standard services rate.

Approve me to go to legal with a short amendment (SLA + capacity pilot) and I’ll coordinate the DocuSign package. Also recommend we include a quarterly DR test milestone for the first year.

Emily — thanks for the call last week. Per our discussion, here’s the agreed path and next steps: 

1) Commercials:
   - 1.5x reserved capacity effective 2028-07-01 with a 6-month pilot at 15% discount on the incremental reserved portion.
   - Conversion option: if FastRetail converts to a 12-month reserved commitment within the 6-month pilot, we will issue a retroactive conversion credit of 50% of the pilot discount.
   - Premium SLA add-on priced at +18% of current committed spend, includes standby region reservation (us-west) and 24/7 response. SLO remediation credit table included in the amendment.

2) Ops & onboarding:
   - Redwood will provide runbook authoring and a tabletop DR test (we will absorb 20 hours; remaining estimated 20 hours billed at services rate).
   - Quarterly DR test milestones scheduled for Q3 and Q4; joint sign-off required.

3) Legal & execution:
   - We’ll issue a short amendment (SLA + capacity pilot) and send via DocuSign. Link: https://www.docusign.com/pack/FR-2028-0451-SLA

Next steps: please confirm the Q3 token/month target (our quote assumes 320M tokens/month) and confirm you’re comfortable with the pilot structure. Once you confirm we’ll route to legal and have a signed amendment by 2028-06-10 to meet the July 1 start.

Thanks again — looking forward to continuing to support your growth.

Best,
